diagnostics.message: google_alloydb_user.users only depends on google_alloydb_cluster.primary (its `cluster` argument), so Terraform can create the database users before the cluster has any primary instance. The AlloyDB users API requires the cluster's primary instance to exist/be ready first — the google_alloydb_user provider documentation adds `depends_on = [google_alloydb_instance.default]` to both the ALLOYDB_BUILT_IN and ALLOYDB_IAM_USER examples for exactly this reason. Without an ordering edge to google_alloydb_instance.primary, `terraform apply` on a fresh project can fail (or force a re-apply) when creating users. Add `depends_on = [google_alloydb_instance.primary]` to google_alloydb_user.users.
